categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the micro-invasive medical devices sector, focusing on the research, manufacturing, and sales of endoscopic diagnostic and therapeutic instruments, microwave/radiofrequency ablation equipment and consumables, and disposable endoscopes. Its product portfolio includes over 60 types of endoscopic instruments across six categories, tumor ablation devices, and disposable imaging systems for bile ducts and bronchi. The company also engages in OEM/ODM services and has expanded into neurosurgery-related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced endoscopic diagnostic and therapeutic techniques such as EMR/ESD, ERCP, EUS/EBUS, and innovative microwave and radiofrequency tumor ablation technologies. The company integrates optical coherence tomography (OCT) and endoscopic OCT (EOCT) for high-resolution imaging. It employs a medical-engineering collaborative R&D model, leveraging multidisciplinary expertise and clinical feedback. Production follows a make-to-order and inventory management approach, with strict quality control and ISO13485 certification, and continuous automation and lean manufacturing improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global medical institutions, including hospitals and clinics specializing in gastroenterology, respiratory medicine, oncology, and neurosurgery. Its products are used in minimally invasive diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, targeting diseases such as digestive tract cancers and tumors. Key markets include China, the United States, Europe, and emerging international regions, with nearly 50% of revenue from overseas markets. Customers include direct hospital clients, distributors, and OEM/ODM partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and has established subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, France, Portugal, Switzerland, Japan, Thailand, and Australia. It has a growing presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Middle East & Africa regions. The company is expanding its global footprint through acquisitions and new production bases, including a new manufacturing facility under construction in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales or distribution to healthcare providers. It manages procurement of raw materials and outsourced manufacturing, maintains inventory, and controls quality throughout the product lifecycle. It also provides OEM/ODM manufacturing services for other brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven growth with emphasis on clinical demand-oriented R&D, development of high-value innovative products, and expansion of AI applications in medical devices. The company invests heavily in R&D (6.33% of revenue), focusing on endoscopic technologies, tumor ablation, disposable endoscopes, and EOCT imaging. It pursues global market expansion, especially in Europe and non-US international markets, and strengthens supply chain resilience and digital transformation. The company also emphasizes talent development and organizational agility.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of medical devices and consumables, including endoscopic instruments, tumor ablation equipment, and disposable endoscopes. Sales channels include direct sales via subsidiaries in key markets, distribution partnerships, and OEM/ODM manufacturing contracts. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue derives from product sales to healthcare institutions globally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's micro-invasive medical device market with a comprehensive product line and strong innovation capabilities. It competes globally with major international medical device companies such as Boston Scientific, Olympus, and Cook in the endoscopy field. Its subsidiary, Kangyou Medical, holds a leading position in microwave ablation technology domestically. The company is recognized for its technological innovation, broad product portfolio, and expanding international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 2.75 billion, representing a 14.26% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 553 million, up 13.85%. Overseas revenue accounts for nearly 50% of total revenue, with significant growth in the Americas and Europe. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and has invested substantially in R&D and production capacity expansion. It has a solid balance sheet with total assets of approximately RMB 4.78 billion and equity of RMB 3.83 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and cost-effective micro-invasive medical devices that improve clinical outcomes, reduce patient pain, and lower healthcare costs. Its products feature advanced imaging, precision ablation technologies, and disposable designs that reduce infection risks. The company leverages deep clinical collaboration and multidisciplinary R&D to rapidly translate clinical needs into differentiated products. Its global regulatory approvals and extensive international marketing network further enhance its competitive advantage.
